description: Track down the specimens Sicilus wishes to study. The list she has given you seems to range mostly of the kind of creatures you can find in a cave near the Corner Path to the West of Wenderwood. It would be wise to bring others with you on this journey.
name: Sicilus Beastiary III
completed: Return to Sicilus at the Zoological Gardens, to the North West of Loch Caplargh, to deliver the specimens to her.
